  • Class
    Description
    AdminLog
    What admins changed, so a server with several staff can see who made a change: one line per change in universe/mods/atomictempest/admin-log/<day>.log, with the time, who, the plugin and what changed.
    Announcements
    Notable moments worth telling people outside the game: a jackpot, a lottery winner, a big win, an achievement.
    Announcements.Listener
     
    BlockFacing
    Turns positions and directions given relative to a block's model into world space, following the way the block was rotated when placed.
    Boosts
    Boosts for a while: more coins from monsters or ores, bigger quest and daily rewards, more battle pass XP, better shop prices.
    Boosts.Source
    Where boosts come from.
    ChatPrefix
    The coloured tag in front of a mod's chat messages, such as "[Slots]", as the admin set it.
    CoinEffects
    Visual coin effects shared by the ATM and other mods.
    CoreAPI
    The version of Core's API, for plugins built on it.
    CraftRestrictions
    Items that only admins may craft unless a setting says otherwise.
    Currency
    The name of the money in every message, from the economy in use: Coins' names as the admin set them on its Currency tab, or the VaultUnlocked economy's own.
    Editions
    Which edition of each plugin is running, for plugins that come as a free and a Pro jar.
    Editions.Edition
    One plugin's edition: what it is called, whether it is Pro, what Pro adds (shown in the free one), and who the Pro copy is licensed to ("" when unknown).
    HudLines
    Short lines of text shown under the coin counter in the corner of the screen.
    ItemIcons
    Item ids that are safe to draw.
    JsonFiles
    Settings and data kept as JSON files, saved with SafeFiles (a crash in the middle of a save leaves a whole copy).
    Lang
    The language of the plugins' texts.
    Leaderboards
    Extra boards for the leaderboards screen (/leaderboards), added by other mods.
    Leaderboards.Board
     
    Mailbox
    One mailbox for every Tempest plugin (Core API version 6).
    Mailbox.Claimed
    What a claim gave.
    Mailbox.Item
    Some of one item.
    Mailbox.ItemGiver
    Gives one kind of item; returns how many did not fit.
    Mailbox.Parcel
    One parcel: who it is from, its title, items and money.
    Perks
    Rank perks: bonuses for players who have a perk's permission.
    Perks.Bonus
    The bonuses a perk can give, each in percent.
    Placeholders
    Named values for each player, such as coins_balance or lottery_pot, for scoreboards, chat formats and placeholder plugins.
    PlayerActions
    Things players do in the economy mods, reported for other mods to count (the Quests mod builds its achievements and quests on them).
    PlayerActions.Listener
     
    PlayLimits
    A daily limit on what each player may stake in games of chance (Slots, Lottery, Coinflip and any game built on Core), set by the admin in /tempest (General, "Daily limit for games"; 0 = no limit).
    RateLimit
    Stops one player from flooding the server: an announcement, payment or message happens at most once in a while per key.
    Registrations
    Everything one plugin adds to Core, taken back with one call in shutdown().
    ReservedDrops
    Items dropped on the ground that only one player can pick up for a while, such as slot machine winnings.
    SafeFiles
    Saving that survives a crash or a power cut in the middle of a save.
    SafeFiles.Parser<T>
    Turns a file's text into something; may throw if the text is not what it should be.
    Themes
    The look of every Tempest menu, chosen by the admin (/tempest, General, "Menu theme"): a preset or their own colours.
    Themes.Theme
    One theme.
    WalletEvents
    Tells other mods about every change to any wallet: who, how much, why and the balance after.
    WalletEvents.Listener
    One change of one wallet.
    WalletEvents.Veto
    Asked before coins leave a wallet.
